submit.title: Error 502: Bad gateway
submit.detail: The origin web server returned an invalid or incomplete response to Cloudflare. This typically indicates the origin is overloaded or misconfigured.
submit.what_you_should_do: **Wait and retry.** Back off for at least 60 seconds. If the error persists, the website operator should check their origin server health and configuration.
submit.footer: This error was generated by Cloudflare on behalf of the website owner.
